01: Dry fabric. And a little resin. How do they become a light, strong composite panel? Give us one minute.
02: You need a mould. A resin pot. A vacuum pump that pulls out the air. A buffer tank that keeps the vacuum steady. And a resin trap that protects the pump.
03: Now the layers. Release agent, so nothing sticks. Reinforcement fabrics, laid in the right directions. Peel ply and flow mesh. Resin enters at one edge; at the other, we pull out the air. Finally, sealant tape and the vacuum bag.
04: Vacuum on: the bag pulls tight over the layers. The valve opens, and air pressure pushes the resin in. It soaks the fabrics – then it cures.
05: Demoulding. Bag, mesh and peel ply come off in one piece, and the finished panel releases from the mould.
